purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Uttar Pradesh's current public BhuNaksha application was followed through its JavaScript/configuration to live first-party endpoints. District 149 बदायूँ and tehsil 00782 बदायूँ were verified through anonymous administrative metadata. Village-level and map-extent requests returned upstream 403 errors, while the application presents a login and CAPTCHA; no parcel geometry or native identity was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Relevant local/state custody is evidenced by the Government of Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council's UP Bhulekh/BhuNaksha services, the Budaun district administration land-records page, and the official digitization dashboard's Badaun-specific linked/geo-referenced village and mapsheet counts. These establish registry custody, not open vector integration.
